offline_text: No contact for {0} hours (switched off, no network or flat battery?).
test_text: If you can read this message, SemplicePhone alerts are working.
v_not_object: the configuration must be a JSON object
v_no_pages: at least one page is needed in "pages"
e_pw_short: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
e_pw_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
e_telegram: The Telegram token does not look valid (format 123456:ABC…).
e_no_channel: No channel configured: enter Telegram or email and save.
e_bad_code: Invalid phone code: 6–32 characters, lowercase letters and digits only.
e_pin: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
m_published: Published. The phone receives it within 15 minutes (with network), immediately with "Update now" in its settings, or with the "#UPDATE" SMS if enabled.
m_forgot: Done: the next phone that connects with this code will be accepted.
title: SemplicePhone – management
welcome_lead: First start: choose the password you will use to enter this panel.
alerts_lead: Get a message right away when something happens on one of the phones.
n_reminder_missed: When a reminder is not confirmed
n_battery: When the battery is almost empty
offline_hours: After how many hours without news
tg_step1_html: In Telegram, message @BotFather, send /newbot and follow the instructions: you get a token.
tg_step2_html: Open the bot you just created and press Start (every family member who wants alerts must do this).
tg_step3_html: To find your chat id, message @userinfobot. For a group, add the bot to the group and use the group id (it starts with -).
mail_hint: Email uses the hosting's mail() function: if it does not arrive, check the spam folder or use Telegram.
cron_hint_html: The check for silent phones runs by itself when someone opens the panel or a phone connects. To run it at night too, if your hosting allows it add a cron job every 10 minutes: {0}
phones_lead: Tap a phone to change its screen, SOS numbers and reminders.
alerts_off_html: Instant alerts (SOS, missed reminders, battery) are not active yet. Set them up.
no_phones: No phone connected. Follow the steps below to connect the first one.
conn_step1_html: On the phone, tap the clock 5 times, enter the PIN and open Remote management.
conn_step2: Copy these two values into the fields on the phone:
conn_step3_html: Turn on the switch and press Update now: the phone appears on this page.
prepare_before: Prepare the configuration before connecting the phone
loaded_version: You loaded the version of {0}. Check it and press "Publish to phone" to apply it.
copied_from: You copied the configuration of "{0}", including SOS numbers and reminders. Check it and press "Publish to phone".
no_notif_access: "Notification access" is missing on the phone: tile badges will not appear until it is granted from the SemplicePhone settings.
name: Name
json_hint: The same configuration in JSON format. Changes made here show up in the other tabs.
copy_from_other: Copy the configuration from another phone
apps_not_received: List not received yet. On the phone (version 0.4.1 or later) open Remote management and press "Update now".
no_news: No news from the phone yet.
reinstalled: Was the phone reinstalled or replaced?
reinstalled_text: For security the panel only accepts the phone that connected the first time. After a reinstall, press here and reconnect the phone.
ignore_offline: Do not alert if this phone stays off
unignore_offline: Turn the "phone unreachable" alert back on
remove_phone: Remove this phone from the panel
remove_phone_confirm: Remove the phone, its history and its alerts from the panel?
footer_html: SemplicePhone {0} · free software AGPL-3.0 — source code
p_dup: Two tiles have the same code ({0}).
p_bad_url: "{0}": the web address must start with https://
p_sos_empty: The SOS button has no numbers: add them in the SOS tab.
how_to_use_text: Tap a tile in the preview to edit it, or a "+" to add a new one.
how_to_use_hint: The grid is what the phone will show. Rows and columns are changed at the top.
pkg_where: (found in the Play Store page address after "id=")
apps_list_hint: The list of installed apps appears here after the phone (version 0.4.1 or later) has pressed "Update now".
wa_hint: The number must be in the phone's contacts, with WhatsApp.
photo_hint: The photo is taken from the phone's contacts based on the number.
overlaps_move: Overlaps "{0}": move it or make it smaller.
last_sos_confirm: This is the last SOS button: remove it anyway?
sos_text: When the SOS button is held, the phone sends an SMS with the location to all these numbers and then calls the first one.
sos_hint: Use the numbers of family or neighbours: apps cannot call emergency services directly.
sms_text_hint: (the location is added at the end)
repeat_every: If no answer, ring again every
rem_intro: At the set time the phone rings and shows the "TAKEN" button full screen. Results appear at the bottom of this page.
ringer_lock_hint: If the phone is set to silent or the volume is lowered, it goes back to the chosen level. This also applies to reminder alarms.
battery_alert_hint: (alert on the Home screen, SMS to the SOS numbers and a message here if alerts are on)
edition_play: Google Play (no automatic SMS: SOS opens Messages ready to send)
edition_warn: This phone has the {0} edition: unread message badges and the "#UPDATE" SMS command only work with the full edition.
badges_hint: Shows how many missed calls and unread messages there are on app tiles. "Notification access" must be granted on the phone.
sms_command_hint: If one of the SOS numbers sends the SMS "#UPDATE" to the phone, it applies the latest published configuration right away instead of waiting for the check (every 15 minutes).
fresh_start_hint: Tapping a tile opens the app on its first screen (chats, messages list…) instead of the last page left open.
photo_fill_hint: If the contact has a photo, it fills the tile with the name below.
upload_failed: Image not uploaded: use JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB.
locate_pending: Request sent: the phone answers at its next check (within 15 minutes, with network).
locate_hint: Works only if "Allow Where is it?" is on in Remote management on the phone.
n_call_blocked: When an unknown call is blocked
n_location: When the location asked with "Where is it?" arrives
photos_hint: They change by themselves on the phone; one tap shows the next. On the phone you can also link folders (Camera, WhatsApp): photos and videos appear by themselves.
block_unknown_hint: Only contacts, SOS numbers and tile numbers ring; other calls are rejected. The call screening role must be granted on the phone.
speaker_calls_hint: Calls from tiles and SOS start on speakerphone, at full volume.
speak_tiles_hint: Holding a tile makes the phone say its name (and the weather).
voice_confirm_hint: Before calling or opening an app the phone says what it is about to do ("Calling Maria").
bedside_hint: While charging and after a minute without touches, a big dimmed clock.
old_app_warn: The phone has app {0}: weather, photos and one-day reminders need version 0.9.0 or later. Update the app first.
missed_hint: Shows who called in the last 3 days and was not called back; tapping a name calls back. Best large (2×2).
missed_hint_play: On the Google Play edition the tile opens the phone call log.
home_button_hint: Inside other apps a "Home" button appears that goes back to SemplicePhone. On the phone, "Display over other apps" must be allowed.
old_app_warn_0100: The phone has app {0}: the missed calls tile and the "Home" button need version 0.10.0 or later. Update the app first.
acc_overlay: The phone lacks "Display over other apps": the "Home" button does not appear.
acc_call_log: The phone lacks the "Call log" permission: the missed calls tile stays empty.
acc_screening: SemplicePhone is not the call screening app: unknown-caller blocking is not active.
acc_contacts: The phone lacks the "Contacts" permission: the call filter blocks nobody until it is granted.
weekly_enable: Every Monday morning, a summary of the week for each phone
weekly_hint: Reminders, SOS, blocked calls, battery and missed contacts, on the same channels as the alerts.
tile_home_button_hint: Untick to hide it in the app opened by this tile (games, full-screen apps).
old_app_warn_0101: The phone has app {0}: hiding the "Home" button for a tile needs version 0.10.1 or later.
search_hint: Opens app search on the phone: type or say part of the name and one tap opens the app.
old_app_warn_0120: The phone has app {0}: the "Search apps" tile needs version 0.12.0 or later.
n_ring_done: When the phone has rung with "Ring the phone"
family_old_app: The phone has app {0}: messages and "Ring the phone" need version 0.13.0 or later.
message_hint: (up to {0} characters: shown full screen and read aloud)
message_placeholder: E.g. I'll come by at 4 pm with some bread.
ring_pending: Request sent: the phone will ring at full volume for 45 seconds, even if it is on silent.
family_hint: The phone checks the portal every 15 minutes: message and ring arrive within a quarter of an hour (immediately with "Update now" or the "#UPDATE" SMS).
auto_answer_hint: If an SOS number calls and nobody answers, the phone answers by itself on speakerphone. On the phone, the call screening role must be granted.
announce_caller_hint: While ringing, the phone says the name ("Maria is calling").
old_app_warn_0130: The phone has app {0}: auto-answer and caller announcement need version 0.13.0 or later.
wiz_lead: Answer a few questions: a complete screen is prepared for you to check and then publish. You can redo it any time.
wiz_replace: The current screen will be replaced (reminders only if you entered some). Continue?
wiz_done: Screen ready: check it and press "Publish to phone".
move_no_room: There is no room on page {0} for this tile at its size: free some space or make it smaller, then try again.
home_label: "HOME" label under the icon (off: icon only, bigger)
phone_changed_info: Last change made on the phone on {0}: {1}. It is already saved here; you can go back from "Previous versions".
family_photo_hint: Optional: if you upload it here it appears on the tile even if the number has no photo in the phone contacts.
messages_hint: Shows unread messages (SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram…): a tap opens the conversation, a long press reads it aloud. Notification access must be granted on the phone. Texts stay on the phone.
messages_hint_basic: With the Google Play version the tile opens the Messages app; the list of unread messages is in the Standard and Full editions.
radio_hint: One or more stations: name and stream address (on the station's website; it often ends with .mp3, .aac or .m3u8). On the phone: big Play/Stop buttons, next station, volume.
night_quiet_hint: At night calls arrive without ringing, except from SOS numbers. The call screening role must be granted on the phone.
charge_reminder_hint: At the chosen time, if the battery is low and not charging, the phone says so aloud and full screen; it repeats after an hour.
hold_to_open_hint: Against accidental touches (tremor): a tile opens only when held for a moment; a short tap says its name.
theme_night: Dark in the evening (9 pm–7 am)
old_app_warn_0140: The phone has app {0}: unread messages, radio, family photos, quiet night, "charge the phone", hold to open and themes need version 0.14.0 or later.
cal_hint: Paste the calendar's secret iCal address (Google Calendar: calendar settings → "Secret address in iCal format"; Outlook and iCloud provide one too). Appointments in the next 14 days become reminders on the phone and update by themselves every 3 hours. Don't edit them in the editor: they are recreated from the calendar.
cal_lead_0: At the time of the appointment
cal_eve: Also remind the evening before at 8 pm
cal_error: Calendar not reachable: check the address
cal_status: {0} appointments in the next 14 days · read {1}
edition_warn_standard: This phone has the standard edition: the "#UPDATE" SMS command and silent updates only work with the full edition.
restricted_hint: With the standard edition on Android 13 or later, if the notification access switch is greyed out: Settings › Apps › SemplicePhone › ⋮ menu › "Allow restricted settings".
video_hint: (up to {0} MB: it appears full screen and starts by itself, then "SEEN IT"; the text, if any, goes under the video)
video_small_host: The hosting accepts uploads up to {0} MB: bigger videos are shrunk in the browser before sending (it takes as long as the video). To raise the limit: upload_max_filesize and post_max_size in .user.ini or in the hosting panel.
video_cannot_shrink: The video is over {0} MB and this browser cannot shrink it: try Chrome or Firefox, or send a shorter video.
e_video_size: The video is too big (at most {0} MB).
e_video_type: Unsuitable video format: use MP4 or WebM.
e_message_or_video: Write a message or choose a video.
album_phone_folders: Linked to {0} phone folders (chosen on the phone).
tpl_autonomous_desc: Already uses the phone well: WhatsApp, unread messages, camera, album, app search, internet.
tpl_calls_desc: Big tiles to call family, missed calls and SOS. Auto-answer, caller announced aloud, unknown numbers blocked.
tpl_memory_desc: Few tiles with photos to call and the album. Opens when held, quiet night, "charge the phone", auto-answer, unknown numbers blocked.
tpl_sight_desc: Taller tiles, high contrast, tile names and callers read aloud.
tpl_hearing_desc: Video calls, written messages and unread messages; speaker on during calls.
tpl_tremor_desc: Taller tiles that open only when held, spoken confirmation, auto-answer.
video_old_app: The phone has app {0}: video messages need version 0.15.0; until then it would only get the text.
name_invite: Give the phone a name so you recognise it in the list and in alerts.
recolored: {0} colours updated to the new palette: publish to send them to the phone.
tg_hint: The number must be in the phone's contacts, with Telegram active and "Sync contacts" on in Telegram (Settings › Privacy); otherwise the chat opens.
old_app_warn_0170: The phone has app {0}: Telegram, torch, magnifier, "where am I", "call me?", music, news, rescuers' card and the new safety and comfort options need version 0.17.0 or later.
remote_apps_hint: If AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk or similar is installed (the fake-technician and fake-bank trick), the phone warns aloud and you get an alert here.
scam_guard_hint: In "Unread messages", messages from strangers with a link are flagged and a tap doesn't open them.
block_premium_hint: 899, 892, 893, 894, 895, 144, 166, 709 and premium short numbers, even dialled from other apps. The outgoing call check must be granted on the phone.
block_international_hint: Numbers on tiles and SOS numbers can always be called, even if foreign; 112 and emergency numbers always.
long_call: Alert if a call with a stranger lasts more than
long_call_hint: Phone scams last long: alert here while the call is still going on.
sim_alert_hint: Useful in case of theft or loss.
inactive: Alert if during the day (8 am–9 pm) the phone is not used for
inactive_hint: No action needed from the elderly person: screen on and Home opened count.
fall_hint: After a hard impact and stillness the phone asks "Are you OK?" with an alarm for 30 seconds; without an answer SOS starts and you get an alert. Uses some battery; may give false alarms.
heat_hint: With very hot forecasts, every 2 hours (10 am–6 pm) the phone reminds to drink and you get an alert here. Uses the Weather tile's place.
zone_hint: Alert when the phone leaves the area around home (and when it comes back), with the location. On the phone, location must be "Allow all the time".
zone_no_last: First request the location ("Where is it?") to use it as home.
zone_full_only: The safe zone only works with the full edition (it needs location in the background).
font_scale_hint: Text, screen timeout and brightness: "Modify system settings" must be granted on the phone; if someone changes them, they go back to what is chosen here.
morning_hint: At the chosen time the phone says the date, the weather and today's reminders.
call_me_hint: One tap asks this family member to call back: they get an SMS (not in the Play version, where the message opens ready to send) and an alert here.
torch_hint: One tap turns the light on or off; it turns off by itself after 15 minutes.
magnifier_hint: The camera as a magnifier: + and − to zoom, light, "FREEZE" to hold the image (medicine boxes, expiry dates, bills).
where_hint: Says the current address aloud and offers to call the first SOS number.
music_hint: Music folders are chosen on the phone (tile editor).
music_folders_n: Linked to {0} music folders on the phone.
news_hint: Headlines are read aloud one at a time, or all in a row.
em_hint: After SOS is sent the phone shows an "Information for rescuers" button with these details, readable and read aloud. They stay on the phone and here.
stock_left: According to the phone, {0} are left.
stock_hint: The phone counts the "Taken" and warns grandparent and family when they are running out.
voice_reply_text: Replied to your message by voice: listen in the portal.
evt_safety_sim_removed: The SIM was removed from the phone
evt_safety_active_again: The phone is being used again
evt_safety_inactive_event: The phone has not been used for {0} hours
evt_safety_zone_left: The phone left the safe zone ({0} m from home)
evt_safety_zone_back: The phone is back in the safe zone ({0} m from home)
evt_find_event_stopped: The phone rang and was stopped after {0} seconds
evt_find_event_rang: The phone rang for {0} seconds, nobody stopped it
evt_callme_event: Asks to be called back by: {0}
evt_fall_event_auto: Possible fall: no answer, SOS started
evt_battery_sms: The phone battery is at {0}%: it should be charged.
evt_long_call_event: Call with a number not in contacts ({0}) going on for more than {1} minutes
alert_lang_hint: Language of email and Telegram alerts for this phone. Usually the phone's own; change it if whoever receives the alerts speaks another language.
alert_lang_phone_unknown: Same as the phone (not known yet)
app_icons_hint: Single colour only for apps that provide it (Android 13+); SemplicePhone app 0.18 or later.
